summary: Final part of the 大盘 (TAIEX) case studies. Finishes (二十) 2007-2009 weekly (second 跌幅满足 leg from 9309, the 'don't buy the rebound, short the neckline break' rule, and the 2009-03-14 volume-breakout triangle/W bottom), then (二十一) 2009-2010 daily (two successive 涨幅满足 targets 7714/8400, the 1/21 破线 + 1/26 trendline-break short, a high-level 破底翻 on 3/8 and time-symmetry of the 套牢区), the 小叮咛 diagrams of failed double bottom / failed triangle / failed head-and-shoulders (strict stop at the neckline), (二十二) 2009-2011 weekly (9229 measured target, M top confirmed 2011-08-06, entry 4780 stop 4688 ≈2% risk, ≈88% profit) and (二十三) 2011-2012 weekly (M-top measured moves 7555 then 6620, the 2012-02-04 W-bottom breakout judged a mere rebound because volume expanded too fast (量放过速) and the bottom was far smaller in time than the top). p171 is a blank MEMO page.

patterns.name_zh: 跌幅满足（等幅计算，第二段）
patterns.name_en: Measured-move downside target from a later swing high
patterns.structure: Take a completed down leg (high A to low B, distance D = A - B). From a subsequent lower swing high C (the start of the next leg down) project C - D. The same downtrend can yield several targets from different highs (9859 and 9309 in 2008).
patterns.entry: Do not buy the weak rebound after the first target; re-enter short when price breaks below the neckline of the rebound consolidation zone (9月1日跌破反弹整理区颈线).
patterns.stop: Reclaiming (站回) the broken rebound-zone neckline.
confirmation: Neckline backtest fails to reclaim (颈线反压未突破站回) → keep the swing short to the big-swing target.

patterns.name_zh: 三角形收敛底部 / W底（带量长红突破颈线底部确立）
patterns.name_en: Converging-triangle / double bottom confirmed by a high-volume long red breakout
patterns.structure: After the downside measured target is reached, ~4 months of base-building forms a converging triangle that is also a W bottom of two lows (3955 and 4164); volume declines through the base (descending line on the volume panel, p161 chart).
patterns.entry: Week the index breaks the neckline (triangle upper line) on a high-volume long red candle (2009-03-14 week); 'about 4780'.
patterns.stop: Low of the volume-start bar (带量起涨低点) 4688, ≈2% risk.

target.formula: W/neckline measured move; later second-wave target = later swing low + first wave (3955→7084)

confirmation: 带量 (volume expansion) on the breakout bar.
Time: base lasted about four months after the target was reached.
invalidation: Falling back below the neckline (see 小叮咛 failed-pattern diagrams).

patterns.name_zh: 涨幅满足（等幅计算，波段中的小波段）
patterns.name_en: Measured-move upside target for successive sub-waves
patterns.structure: In a big bull swing, each pullback low plus the prior sub-wave's rise gives the next target; each time price clears the prior high (越过前高/再过前高) a new target is computed. Lows 6100 and 6629 form the up trendline (上升趋势线).
patterns.entry: Not specified for this example beyond holding the swing long; new target computed when price makes a new high above the prior high.
patterns.stop: Break of the up trendline (跌破上升趋势线) / 破线 is the first danger signal; swing longs usually sell first (先卖再说).
confirmation: Pullback holds above the up trendline (p164).
invalidation: 破线 (break of short-term line) and break of the up trendline.

patterns.name_zh: 破线 / 跌破上升趋势线放空
patterns.name_en: Short on line break, add on uptrend-line break
patterns.structure: After the upside target is reached and price tops (盘头), a break of the short-term line (破线) confirms the short; a later break of the up trendline is an add-on.
patterns.entry: 1/21 破线短头确立: short ≈8175; 1/26 break of up trendline: add short ≈7820.
patterns.stop: First short: above prior high 8395 (risk ≈2.7%). Add-on: break above 8015, i.e. reclaiming the line (risk ≈2.5%).

target.formula: not given numerically; covered when a reversal signal (高档破底翻) appears
target.worked_example: Cover ≈7760 after the 3/8 high-level 破底翻

confirmation: Upside measured target reached and topping (盘头大幅拉回).
invalidation: Reclaiming the broken line / 破底翻 back above it.

patterns.structure: After breaking down from a high-level trapped zone, price reclaims the broken line/zone (3/8/2010 站回线上), turning the short trend.
patterns.entry: Re-enter longs only selectively: prefer stocks that turned strong first; no entry if volume/price has not confirmed (量价不表态不介入); small size.

target.worked_example: Index later consolidated ~7 months in the zone before the second big bull wave

confirmation: Volume-price confirmation in the stocks chosen.

patterns.structure: Two heads (9220/9180 and 9099) over ~11 months; neckline ~8245 at the double-head line; confirmed by a weekly high-volume long black candle piercing the neckline (2011-08-06).
patterns.entry: Breakdown through the neckline (break position ≈8490 on the chart).
patterns.stop: Not specified in this example (failed H&S diagram p166: reclaiming the neckline is the stop).

target.formula: target_1 = breakdown_level - (head - neckline); target_2 = target_1 - same distance

confirmation: 带量长黑贯破颈线 (high-volume long black candle through the neckline).

patterns.name_zh: 量放过速的反弹（底部规模远小于头部）
patterns.name_en: Too-fast volume expansion breakout = rebound, not a new bull
patterns.structure: A W bottom (6877 / 6609) breaks its neckline on a weekly long red with volume expanding too fast (9114亿 spike), but the bottom took ~5.5 months versus a ~10.5-11 month head zone above 8200.
patterns.entry: Treat as a rebound only (应以反弹视之); not a long-term bull entry.
patterns.stop: Short-term head confirmed when the neckline breaks again (2012-04-07 week).

target.formula: not given; index fell back to the starting zone
target.worked_example: Feb 2012 rebound to ~8170, 4/7 neckline break, back to the start zone

confirmation: Bottom time-scale far smaller than the top; volume spike rather than gradual expansion.

patterns.name_zh: 失败的双底 / 失败的收敛三角形底部 / 失败的头肩顶
patterns.name_en: Failed double bottom / failed triangle bottom / failed head-and-shoulders top (stop rules)
patterns.structure: Schematics: price breaks the neckline (buy/short signal), then falls back below (or reclaims above) the neckline.
patterns.entry: Double bottom & triangle: buy on neckline breakout (突破颈线买进信号). H&S top: short on neckline break (跌破颈线放空信号).
patterns.stop: Long: falling back below the neckline (跌落颈线下停损). Short: reclaiming the neckline (站回颈线停损).
invalidation: The neckline re-cross itself is the invalidation and the stop.

rules.rule: Within one downtrend, a downside measured target can also be computed from a later lower high (9309), not only the top.
rules.quote_zh: 在9309点起跌的波段跌势中，亦可计算出跌深反弹低点附近位置。

rules.rule: In a long-term bear structure, don't buy the weak rebound; sell short on highs. The best re-entry for shorts is the break of the rebound consolidation neckline, stopped on reclaiming the neckline; if the neckline backtest fails, hold the swing short to the big-swing target — small losses, big gains.
rules.quote_zh: 结构上属弱势反弹，因此长空的结构当中，以不抢反弹逢高空为原则，而这次反弹后的最佳布空点，“9月1日跌破反弹整理区颈线”便是空单再次进场时机，停损设在站回颈线时，颈线反压未突破站回则波段空单一路抱至大波段跌幅满足附近，这便是小赔大赚的波段操作方式。

rules.rule: After a big market drop, only bottom-fish individual stocks you are confident in (with money management); otherwise wait for a technical bottom confirmation before actively buying swing longs.
rules.quote_zh: 在大盘大跌后，除非有把握的个股逢低承接布局多单（但需注意资金控管），否则在技术面底部确立后，才做积极介入波段多单的动作。

rules.rule: A high-volume long red candle breaking the neckline after ~4 months of base confirms the bottom and is the swing buy point.
rules.quote_zh: 经过约四个月的打底期至2009年3月14日当周，带量长红突破颈线底部确立，为波段买进时机，结构上明显为三角形收敛型态，亦可视为3955点及4164点两个低点的双底型态，也就是所谓的W底

rules.rule: Understanding volume-price structure lets you time entries and compensates for blind spots of fundamentals.
rules.quote_zh: 研究并深入了解技术面的量价结构，相对容易切入最佳时机的空点或买点，弥足基本面的盲点。

rules.rule: Each new high above the prior high allows computing a new measured target; two lows (6100, 6629) define the up trendline.
rules.quote_zh: 越过前高至7185点拉回后同年9月7日再创新高，便能计算涨幅满足，且6229低点确立与前低6100点，形成一条上升趋势线。

rules.rule: The first break of the up trendline after the target is the first danger signal for the swing long: sell longs first to avoid the risk of entering a bear phase.
rules.quote_zh: 这次1月21日破线短头确立，及1月26日跌破上升趋势线，首度出现结束波段多头的危机，此时波段多单通常先卖再说，避开进入空头的风险。

rules.rule: A 破底翻 at a high level is a stabilization signal but far riskier than a low-level one: choose stocks that turned strong first, don't enter unless volume/price confirms, small size.
rules.quote_zh: 不过在角度较高的地方做破底翻，虽然也是企稳信号，但相对低档破底翻的风险高出很多，因此在多单的重新介入除了慎选个股外（以先转强的类股为主，原则上量价不表态不介入），资金控管少量操作，尽量降低容错率。

rules.rule: Time symmetry: once a zone becomes a trapped zone (套牢区), reversing it needs at least a symmetric amount of time of sideways consolidation to digest the supply.
rules.quote_zh: 理论上扭转结构也需要对称以上的时间，以盘代跌整理消化卖压。

rules.rule: Short on the 破线 confirmation with stop above the prior high; add on the trendline break with stop on reclaiming the line; cover when a high-level 破底翻 reverses the trend.
rules.quote_zh: 主要的重点在于1月21日破线短头确立空单进场，约可空在8175点附近，突破前高8395点停损，风险约2.7%。

rules.rule: The book shows successful patterns, but strictly executing stops is the key to success.
rules.quote_zh: 本书以成功的操作型态为主，但实际的操作上严格执行停损才是成功的重要关键。

rules.rule: Failed patterns: for double bottoms and triangle bottoms, a neckline breakout is the buy signal and falling back below the neckline is the stop; for a head-and-shoulders top, the neckline break is the short signal and reclaiming the neckline is the stop.
rules.quote_zh: 突破颈线买进信号……跌落颈线下停损……跌破颈线放空信号……站回颈线停损

rules.rule: Weekly neckline breakout is the buy signal; breaking back below the neckline is the stop.
rules.quote_zh: 9月18日当周突破颈线为买进信号，跌破颈线停损。

rules.rule: Compare time scales: a bottom far smaller in time than the preceding M top, plus too-fast volume expansion, means the main force is in a hurry — a short-lived rebound (escape rally), not a new bull.
rules.quote_zh: 但底部的时间规模五个多月，远低于M头规模，且放量过速，如当时部落格预测主力求急不求长久，看短不看长，属于M头长空型态的反弹逃命波

rules.rule: Long entry on the volume breakout week with stop at the volume-start low (~2% risk) captured ~88%; even if shaken out in the early-2010 chop, ~58% remained.
rules.quote_zh: 约可买在4780点附近停损设带量起涨低点4688点风险约2%，达涨幅满足附近，获利了结约88%。

rules.rule: When the weekly pattern signals a turn, look at shorter timeframes (daily, even hourly or 5-minute volume-price) for a more timely entry.
rules.quote_zh: 日线操作较即时，因此型态上有转折机会时，可观察较短K线，甚至是小时线或五分钟线的量价结构，以求更即时积极的介入时机。

rules.rule: Livermore: only enter when entry conditions are fully met; one who trades every day cannot have enough reasons to be rational every time.
rules.quote_zh: 使我犯错的是我没有足够的毅力按计划做，即只有在先满足入场条件时才入场。对每天都要买卖的人来说，他不可能有足够的理由和知识，使他每天的买卖都是理性的。

rules.rule: M top measured move: distance from the head to the neckline is subtracted from the breakdown level; the second-wave target subtracts it again.
rules.quote_zh: 跌破颈线的位置约在8490点－935点＝等幅计算的跌幅满足7555点。

rules.rule: At the second downside target, together with a daily 破底翻, flip from short to long.
rules.quote_zh: 台股达第二波跌幅满足附近（最低6609点），配合日线出现破底翻后，便应翻空为多。

rules.rule: A ~5.5-month bottom under a ~10.5-month top above 8200 is too small; until a consolidation of comparable time scale occurs, treat the breakout as a rebound.
rules.quote_zh: 大盘周线长红，突破颈线型态上约五个半月的底部成型，但相对上档8200点以上约10个半月的大头部区，规模差异仍大。因此未达相对时间规模的整理之前，应以反弹视之。

rules.rule: Volume expanding too fast means the main force is in a hurry (insiders look short-term), unlike a big bull's gradual volume expansion; it lures retail (margin rises) and is usually followed by sector-rotation topping/consolidation so the main force can distribute while pulling up.
rules.quote_zh: 量价结构上量放过速表示主力求急，而非大多头逐步放量求长久结构，表示业内作价看短不看长，但是量放过速也表示业内成功作量吸引散户进场（融资增加）。通常都还会有一段类股轮动的盘头或盘涨期，以利其边拉边跑的动作。

worked_examples.pattern: 跌幅满足 (from 9309) → 弱势反弹 → 跌破反弹整理区颈线再空
worked_examples.outcome: Reached near target (low 6708), ~1-month weak rebound to 7376, 9/1 neckline break re-short to the big-swing target (4225 per p161)

worked_examples.pattern: 三角形收敛 / W底 (3955, 4164) 带量长红突破颈线
worked_examples.outcome: Bottom confirmed; swing long; ≈88% profit at 涨幅满足 (p168)

worked_examples.pattern: 涨幅满足 ×2 → 破线/跌破上升趋势线 → 高档破底翻
worked_examples.outcome: Both targets reached; short from 8175/7820 covered ≈7760 after 3/8 high-level 破底翻; trapped zone consolidated ~7 months before the second bull wave continued

worked_examples.pattern: 三角形收敛底 → 突破整理区颈线 → 涨幅满足 → M头
worked_examples.outcome: Target hit Feb 2011 (9220); ~11-month M top confirmed by a high-volume long black candle 2011-08-06; 2012-02-04 too-fast-volume breakout was an escape rebound, index fell back to the start zone

worked_examples.pattern: M头跌幅满足 ×2 → 破底翻 W底 (6877, 6609) → 量放过速反弹 → 4/7 跌破颈线
worked_examples.outcome: Both downside targets reached; rebound faded as predicted; index back to the start zone

quantifiable: Downside measured target: for any completed down leg (H1→L1), and any later lower swing high H2, target = H2 - (H1 - L1); flag when low comes within a tolerance of the target.
Upside sub-wave target: on each new close above the prior swing high, target = latest pullback low + (prior wave high - prior wave low).
M-top target: neckline = low between two heads; D = head - neckline; target_1 = breakdown_price - D; target_2 = target_1 - D.
Breakout confirmation: weekly bar closes above the neckline with volume above its recent average (带量长红) and a long-bodied red candle.
Stop for neckline breakout long: low of the breakout bar (带量起涨低点) or a close back below the neckline; for neckline short: close back above the neckline.

Rebound-vs-reversal filter: if bottom_duration / prior_top_duration < ~0.5 and the breakout bar volume is a spike (e.g. > N× average) rather than a gradual ramp, classify the breakout as a rebound (lower conviction / shorter holding).
Time-symmetry filter: after a trendline break from a top zone of duration T, expect at least ~T of sideways consolidation before a new uptrend leg.
High-level 破底翻 (reclaim of the broken line near the top) → reduce position size versus a low-level 破底翻; require volume confirmation.
ambiguities: p162 says the index fell to the 6834 target 'in mid-November 2008 (low 6708)' and then rebounded to 7376 before the '9月1日' neckline break; on the p161 chart 6708.46 and 7376 come well before the late-2008 3955 low, so '11月中旬' appears to be a date error (the 9/1 break would then be 2008-09-01).
p163 text says '6229低点' forms the trendline with 6100, but the chart label and the 观察重点一 computation use 6629 — 6229 is likely a typo for 6629.
The 7714 target (p163) was overshot to 7811 and the 8400 target was missed by 5 points (8395); 'near the target' tolerance is never quantified.
p165 short entry 8175 with stop at the prior high 8395 — the stop is a structural level, not the 5-7% rule used elsewhere; risk was only ~2.7% because entry was close to the high.
The 'M head' heads are labeled 9220.69 on p167 chart and '9180' on the p169 chart/text; the measured distance 935 uses 9180, not the absolute high 9220.
p170 quotes the blog as '量放进速' while the rest of the text uses '量放过速' — probably the same concept (possible typo).
No numeric definition of '量放过速' (how fast is too fast) or of the bottom/top time-scale ratio that separates a rebound from a reversal.
p168: '获利了结约88%' — the exit price is not stated; 88% from 4780 implies ≈8990, i.e. below the 9229 target.
